issues.description: Network-level httpx.RequestError failures are not retried or wrapped, so transient transport failures bypass the client's retry/error contract.
Resource IDs are interpolated directly into URL paths without percent-encoding, so IDs containing reserved characters can call the wrong endpoint or fail unexpectedly.
Retry-After parsing only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After headers.
Successful response bodies are parsed without schema/error guarding, causing raw JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError, or ValueError leaks on malformed API responses.
BatchItemResult accepts invalid status/task/error combinations without validation, allowing contradictory batch results into user code.
Retry timing configuration is not validated, so negative backoff values or caps can produce invalid sleep durations.
The package advertises full type hints but does not ship a py.typed marker for downstream type checkers.
__version__ is duplicated separately from pyproject.toml, creating avoidable release-version drift.
